% Common formatting fixes for academic papers.
% Include this file in your preamble or apply these settings as needed.

% --- Widow and Orphan Control ---
\widowpenalty=10000
\clubpenalty=10000

% --- Better text rendering ---
\usepackage{microtype}

% --- Float placement ---
% Force floats to appear in the section where they are defined
\usepackage[section]{placeins}

% --- Better table formatting ---
\usepackage{booktabs}
\usepackage{tabularx}

% --- Useful for resizing overfull tables ---
% Usage: \resizebox{\columnwidth}{!}{\begin{tabular}...\end{tabular}}
\usepackage{graphicx}

% --- Subfigures ---
\usepackage{subcaption}

% --- Compact lists (reduce vertical spacing in itemize/enumerate) ---
\usepackage{enumitem}
\setlist{nosep}

% --- URL line breaking ---
\usepackage{url}
\urlstyle{same}

% --- Reduce spacing around section titles (if needed) ---
